summary.en: Holds the liquid and leaves its surface open.
summary.zh: 盛放液体，杯口保持敞开。

detail.en: This open glass beaker has a thin wall, a thick base, a rounded rim and a small pouring lip. Its printed millilitre scale is approximate, and its water surface is shown separately. [S27]
detail.zh: 敞口玻璃烧杯有薄壁、厚杯底、圆润杯沿和小杯嘴。印上的毫升刻度只是近似值，水面单独显示。[S27]

summary.en: Keeps the bath at the selected temperature.
summary.zh: 表示保持选定温度的水。

detail.en: An external source keeps the bath at the selected temperature as it exchanges energy with the spoons. The bath’s temperature stays fixed in the calculation. [S27]
detail.zh: 外部来源维持选定浴温，让水与勺子交换能量时仍保持恒温。计算中，浴温不变。[S27]

summary.en: Carries heat between the bath and its far end.
summary.zh: 在温浴与勺柄远端之间传热。

detail.en: A shallow bowl joins a continuous handle. The two model spoons have the same shape, immersion depth, starting temperature and tip heat capacity: the energy needed for each degree of warming. Their heat-transfer rates were chosen for comparison, rather than measured from real spoons. [S27]
detail.zh: 浅勺碗与完整勺柄相连。两把模型勺子的形状、浸入深度、初温和远端热容量相同。热容量表示升高一度需要多少能量。传热快慢是比较用的设定，不是实测值。[S27]

summary.en: Carries heat between the bath and its far end.
summary.zh: 在温浴与勺柄远端之间传热。

detail.en: A shallow bowl joins a continuous handle. The two model spoons have the same shape, immersion depth, starting temperature and tip heat capacity: the energy needed for each degree of warming. Their heat-transfer rates were chosen for comparison, rather than measured from real spoons. [S27]
detail.zh: 浅勺碗与完整勺柄相连。两把模型勺子的形状、浸入深度、初温和远端热容量相同。热容量表示升高一度需要多少能量。传热快慢是比较用的设定，不是实测值。[S27]

summary.en: Indicates the model temperature at the far end.
summary.zh: 指示模型中勺柄远端的温度。

detail.en: This separate pointer shows the temperature at the far end of the handle. Other places along a real spoon can have different temperatures. The colours show temperature; a warm spoon does not glow. [S27]
detail.zh: 独立指示片显示勺柄远端的温度。真实勺子其他位置的温度可能不同。颜色用来表示温度，温热勺子本身不会发光。[S27]

summary.en: Indicates the model temperature at the far end.
summary.zh: 指示模型中勺柄远端的温度。

detail.en: This separate pointer shows the temperature at the far end of the handle. Other places along a real spoon can have different temperatures. The colours show temperature; a warm spoon does not glow. [S27]
detail.zh: 独立指示片显示勺柄远端的温度。真实勺子其他位置的温度可能不同。颜色用来表示温度，温热勺子本身不会发光。[S27]

summary.en: Measures temperature with its bulb in the water.
summary.zh: 感温端浸入水中以测量温度。

detail.en: The sensing bulb sits in the water, clear of the bottom and wall. A support holds the stem. The separate indicator moves evenly with temperature as a diagram; it does not calculate an expanding liquid’s volume. [S27]
detail.zh: 感温端浸在水中，不碰杯底或杯壁。支架固定测温杆。旁边的指示片随温度均匀移动，只作图示，不计算液体膨胀的体积。[S27]

summary.en: Its top marks the model temperature on the probe.
summary.zh: 液柱顶端标示探头对应的模型温度。

detail.en: The liquid column and card use the same temperature value before rounding. The column rises inside the stem to show that temperature, without calculating a liquid volume. [S27]
detail.zh: 液柱和卡片使用同一个取整前的温度值。液柱在杆内升高来显示温度，不计算液柱体积。[S27]

summary.en: Supports the clamp above the open bath.
summary.zh: 支承敞口温浴上方的夹具。

detail.en: The base rests on the bench. The upright and clamp support the probe without holding its bulb against the cup. [S27]
detail.zh: 底座落在台面上。直杆与夹具支承温度计，不让感温端贴住烧杯。 [S27]

summary.en: Holds the stem while the bulb stays immersed.
summary.zh: 夹住测温杆，让感温端保持浸没。

detail.en: The horizontal arm joins the stand with a screw clamp. Padded jaws hold the thermometer stem, so the probe stays above the cup bottom. [S27]
detail.zh: 横臂用螺钉夹连接铁架台。带衬垫的夹爪夹住温度计杆，感温端与杯底留有间隔。[S27]

summary.en: Supplies energy at the selected power.
summary.zh: 按选定功率供给能量。

detail.en: The electric heater supports an open beaker. In this ideal model, all supplied energy heats the water; the container absorbs none and no heat escapes. Use the time control to advance the experiment. RUN only switches the moving symbols on or off. [S27]
detail.zh: 电热台支承敞口烧杯。理想模型中，供给的能量全部用于加热水，容器不吸热，也没有散热。用时间控件推进实验；RUN 只开关移动符号。[S27]

summary.en: Holds the liquid and leaves its surface open.
summary.zh: 盛放液体，杯口保持敞开。

detail.en: This open glass beaker has a thin wall, a thick base, a rounded rim and a small pouring lip. Its printed millilitre scale is approximate, and its water surface is shown separately. [S27]
detail.zh: 敞口玻璃烧杯有薄壁、厚杯底、圆润杯沿和小杯嘴。印上的毫升刻度只是近似值，水面单独显示。[S27]

summary.en: Warms as the heater supplies energy.
summary.zh: 获得加热器供给的能量而升温。

detail.en: Set the water’s mass with the control. Its drawn level stays fixed, so read the control rather than estimating mass or volume from the picture. [S27]
detail.zh: 用控件设定水的质量。画面的水位不变，要读控件数值，不要从图中估计质量或体积。[S27]

summary.en: Measures temperature with its bulb in the water.
summary.zh: 感温端浸入水中以测量温度。

detail.en: The sensing bulb sits in the water, clear of the bottom and wall. A support holds the stem. The separate indicator moves evenly with temperature as a diagram; it does not calculate an expanding liquid’s volume. [S27]
detail.zh: 感温端浸在水中，不碰杯底或杯壁。支架固定测温杆。旁边的指示片随温度均匀移动，只作图示，不计算液体膨胀的体积。[S27]

summary.en: Its top marks the model temperature on the probe.
summary.zh: 液柱顶端标示探头对应的模型温度。

detail.en: The liquid column and card use the same temperature value before rounding. The column rises inside the stem to show that temperature, without calculating a liquid volume. [S27]
detail.zh: 液柱和卡片使用同一个取整前的温度值。液柱在杆内升高来显示温度，不计算液柱体积。[S27]

summary.en: Holds the liquid and leaves its surface open.
summary.zh: 盛放液体，杯口保持敞开。

detail.en: This open glass beaker has a thin wall, a thick base, a rounded rim and a small pouring lip. Its printed millilitre scale is approximate, and its water surface is shown separately. [S27]
detail.zh: 敞口玻璃烧杯有薄壁、厚杯底、圆润杯沿和小杯嘴。印上的毫升刻度只是近似值，水面单独显示。[S27]

summary.en: Exchanges heat with the surroundings.
summary.zh: 与周围环境交换热量。

detail.en: The water exchanges heat with surroundings held at 25 °C. The transfer setting describes the whole route between them, rather than the conductivity of one material. [S27]
detail.zh: 水与保持 25 °C 的环境交换热量。传热参数描述两者之间的整条通路，并非某一种材料的导热率。[S27]

summary.en: Measures temperature with its bulb in the water.
summary.zh: 感温端浸入水中以测量温度。

detail.en: The sensing bulb sits in the water, clear of the bottom and wall. A support holds the stem. The separate indicator moves evenly with temperature as a diagram; it does not calculate an expanding liquid’s volume. [S27]
detail.zh: 感温端浸在水中，不碰杯底或杯壁。支架固定测温杆。旁边的指示片随温度均匀移动，只作图示，不计算液体膨胀的体积。[S27]

summary.en: Its top marks the model temperature on the probe.
summary.zh: 液柱顶端标示探头对应的模型温度。

detail.en: The liquid column and card use the same temperature value before rounding. The column rises inside the stem to show that temperature, without calculating a liquid volume. [S27]
detail.zh: 液柱和卡片使用同一个取整前的温度值。液柱在杆内升高来显示温度，不计算液柱体积。[S27]

summary.en: Slows heat transfer into or out of the water.
summary.zh: 减慢能量传入水中或从水中传出。

detail.en: The sleeve surrounds the cup and leaves its mouth open. It slows heat transfer without supplying energy. It can slow both the cooling of hot water and the warming of cold water. [S27]
detail.zh: 包覆层围住杯身，杯口保持敞开。它不供能，只减慢传热，既能减慢热水冷却，也能减慢冷水变暖。[S27]

summary.en: Marks the space between the cup and its wrap.
summary.zh: 标示烧杯与包覆层之间的间隙。

detail.en: This ring-shaped gap lies between the cup and its wrap. It is part of the insulation. The model does not calculate a separate temperature for the air in the gap. [S27]
detail.zh: 杯身与包覆层之间留有环形空隙，是隔热结构的一部分。模型不单独计算空隙中的空气温度。[S27]

summary.en: Provides a solid with a freely moving right end.
summary.zh: 表示右端能够自由伸缩的固体杆。

detail.en: In the model, the rod is 100 mm long at 25 °C. The drawn rod stays at this length. A separate pointer shows its calculated length change enlarged 500 times. [S27]
detail.zh: 模型中，杆在 25 °C 时长 100 mm。画出的杆保持这个长度，独立指示片显示放大 500 倍的计算伸缩量。[S27]

summary.en: Shows rod-end displacement enlarged 500 times.
summary.zh: 显示放大500倍的杆端位移。

detail.en: The pointer is separate from the rod. When the calculated extension is 0.072 mm, the pointer moves 0.036 m in the diagram. It moves left when the rod contracts. Read the actual calculated extension from the number. [S27]
detail.zh: 指示片与杆分开。计算伸长 0.072 mm 时，图中指示片移动 0.036 m；杆收缩时，指示片向左移动。计算的实际伸缩量要看数字。[S27]

summary.en: Supports the rod without locking both ends.
summary.zh: 托住钢杆，不把两端同时锁死。

detail.en: The shallow, open support lets the rod slide along its length as temperature changes. The two supports hold it up without clamping both ends in place. [S27]
detail.zh: 开放的浅槽托住杆，让杆随温度变化沿长度方向滑动。两个支座承托杆身，不把两端锁死。[S27]

summary.en: Supports the rod without locking both ends.
summary.zh: 托住钢杆，不把两端同时锁死。

detail.en: The shallow, open support lets the rod slide along its length as temperature changes. The two supports hold it up without clamping both ends in place. [S27]
detail.zh: 开放的浅槽托住杆，让杆随温度变化沿长度方向滑动。两个支座承托杆身，不把两端锁死。[S27]

summary.en: Compares a cold ball with its warmed illustration.
summary.zh: 比较小球原状与受热后的示意状态。

detail.en: The brass ball hangs on a chain from a wooden handle. The ball-and-ring picture enlarges the size change to make it visible. It is a separate comparison from the rod and uses neither the rod’s dimensions nor its expansion coefficient. It gives no numerical ball temperature or expansion. [S27]
detail.zh: 黄铜球用链条挂在木柄下。球环图放大尺寸变化，方便观察。它与杆是不同的比较，不采用杆的尺寸或膨胀系数，也没有给出球的温度或膨胀量数值。[S27]

summary.en: Keeps the original opening for the ball comparison.
summary.zh: 在小球对照中保持原来的孔。

detail.en: The brass ring has an open hole, 44 mm wide in this model, and a wooden handle. It stays unchanged while the ball warms. If the ring were heated too, it would expand. [S27]
detail.zh: 黄铜圆环中间有通孔，模型孔宽 44 mm，并装有木柄。球受热时，环保持原状。如果环也受热，它也会膨胀。[S27]

summary.en: Shows a longer liquid column in a glass tube above a flask.
summary.zh: 在烧瓶上方的玻璃管中显示变长的液柱。

detail.en: The coloured liquid column in the tube lengthens while the flask, stopper, tube and scale stay fixed. This picture shows liquid expansion without calculating a volume or temperature. [S27]
detail.zh: 管中的有色液柱变长，烧瓶、塞子、玻璃管和刻度保持固定。画面说明液体膨胀，不计算体积或温度。[S27]

summary.en: Contains the gas below a movable piston.
summary.zh: 围住可动活塞下方的气体。

detail.en: The clear cylinder has a fixed bottom and an open top. In the warm view, the piston moves up to give the gas more space. The picture does not calculate pressure or volume using a gas law. [S27]
detail.zh: 透明筒底部固定，上端敞开。受热视图中，活塞上移，给气体更多空间。画面不使用气体定律计算压强或体积。[S27]

summary.en: Moves to leave more space for warmed gas.
summary.zh: 移动以给受热气体留出更大空间。

detail.en: This disc has a slender handle. Its two positions show gas taking up more space beneath a movable piston. A rigid sealed container would hold the volume fixed. [S27]
detail.zh: 圆盘带有细柄。两个位置显示气体在可动活塞下占据更多空间。刚性密闭容器则会限制体积。[S27]

summary.en: Holds both spoons at the same immersion depth.
summary.zh: 把两勺固定在相同浸入深度。

detail.en: An upright and crossbar support both spoon handles. Short tabs touch the handles without covering the bowls. The holder keeps both bowls immersed to the same depth. [S27]
detail.zh: 立柱与横梁支承两根勺柄。短托片接触勺柄，不遮住勺碗，让两个勺碗保持相同浸入深度。[S27]

summary.en: Holds its probe clear of the cup wall and bottom.
summary.zh: 支承探头，让感温端不碰杯壁和杯底。

detail.en: The base rests on the bench beside the cup. A screw clamp joins the upright and arm, and padded jaws hold the probe stem above the open mouth. [S27]
detail.zh: 底座放在烧杯旁的台面上。螺钉夹连接立杆与横臂，带衬垫的夹爪在杯口上方夹住探头杆。[S27]

summary.en: Holds its probe clear of the cup wall and bottom.
summary.zh: 支承探头，让感温端不碰杯壁和杯底。

detail.en: The base rests on the bench beside the cup. A screw clamp joins the upright and arm, and padded jaws hold the probe stem above the open mouth. [S27]
detail.zh: 底座放在烧杯旁的台面上。螺钉夹连接立杆与横臂，带衬垫的夹爪在杯口上方夹住探头杆。[S27]

summary.en: Marks the fixed environment used by the cooling model.
summary.zh: 标示冷却模型采用的固定环境温度。

detail.en: The surroundings stay at 25 °C in this simulation. This chosen temperature is not a live reading of your room or Singapore weather. [S27]
detail.zh: 模拟环境保持 25 °C。这个设定温度不是你的房间或新加坡天气的实时读数。[S27]

summary.en: Supports the independent model apparatus.
summary.zh: 支承各个独立模型的器材。

detail.en: The model bench is 1.8 × 0.7 m, with its top at 0.75 m. It holds separate experiments whose energy transfers are not connected. In the liquid-column picture, the flask and glass tube stay fixed while only the coloured column lengthens. [S27]
detail.zh: 模型台面为 1.8 × 0.7 m，高 0.75 m。它承托独立实验，各自的能量传递互不相连。液柱图中的烧瓶和玻璃管保持固定，只有有色液柱变长。[S27]
